rows.text: Shh... Listen, each song has its own story. Maybe you can listen to some when you have the time?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Ehhhh! Don't bring the dirt in here! Pom-Pom just swept!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: It's dirty again all thanks to you!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Pom-Pom can't go outside, yet even from here, the stars are still so pretty to look at.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: So... the outside world. What do you think it's like?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: More water for you to grow taller, taller, taller!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Do you need to be watered too? It looks like you've grown tall enough already.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: ...Zzzzz... What's going on? Did something happen?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Pom-Pom isn't a robot! Train conductor needs breaks too!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Hmmm... how can a button be so stubborn...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Eh, there doesn't seem to be anything special going on.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Hm... the coach is quiet. Maybe a little too quiet?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Ah... Standing for such a long time makes Pom-Pom want to take a nap.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Not to brag or anything, but the lighting and temperature here are carefully calibrated by Pom-Pom, so it's normal to get sleepy.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom
